title: Utopia Conflict
summary: Presentation-ready hardlight district combat mission with capture routes, four district field activities, semantic enemy colors, six weapon signatures, and source Vector Arena integration.
core_loop: enter the city -> choose a visible field activity or capture route -> fight with hardlight weapons -> secure nodes / open Vector Arena -> earn points -> upgrade body, armor, or ammo -> continue district activities

controls.swap_weapon: TAB cycles right hand; Q cycles left hand; number keys select right; Shift+number selects left
controls.exit: ESC then Quit to Desktop; 0 direct legacy/debug exit
controls.interact: E starts a nearby visible activity station or enters an open Vector Arena portal; signal fragments can still be walked into or shot
controls.district_travel: travel north from spawn to enter High Towers; travel east to enter Pyramid Sector
controls.weapon_slots: 1 Core Lance, 2 Imploder, 3 Proximity Magnet, 4 Disassembler, 5 Burst Splitter, 6 Auto Lattice
controls.upgrades: U buys ammo capacity; Shift+U buys health capacity; I buys armor shell capacity using shared points
controls.activity_stations: Calibration: Core Sample and Imploder Study; High Towers: Shield Fracture; Pyramid Sector: Magnet Garden

score_rules.score_source: node captures, signal fragments, weapon kills, arena waves, arena clears, chain ruptures, extraction bonus
score_rules.complete_when: all command nodes are captured, required signal fragments are recovered, and the return lattice is reached
score_rules.save_scope: local mission result packet; Prototype Lab validates and saves shared points
score_rules.upgrade_spend: shared local points earned in city and arena can be spent on ammo capacity, health capacity, and armor shell capacity

notes: Pass39 removes health-bar HUD direction and makes player condition readable through weapon/armor wireframe color: green body at full health, amber mid, red near empty, with armor as a cyan shell that absorbs damage first and fades toward the current health state when hit. Pass55 repairs pause/settings selection with visible keyboard navigation and preserves mouse button control.
name: Utopia Conflict

health_and_armor_readability.health_readout: weapon/armor wireframe color gradient, not a health bar
health_and_armor_readability.body_gradient: green full -> amber mid -> red empty
health_and_armor_readability.armor_readout: cyan wireframe shell; hit damage exposes/fades toward current body-health color
